body: # Fed cuts key US lending rate by quarter point to lowest level in three years. The US central bank says it will cut the country's key lending rate by a quarter point. Federal Reserve Board Chair Jerome Powell tells reporters the decision was taken as the US labour market cools and "inflation remains somewhat elevated" - you can follow his remarks by clicking **watch live** above. This is the last rate decision from the board before the end of the year - made with less data than usual after the government shutdown. US President Donald Trump has long been an advocate for lower interest rates and has threatened Powell's future as chair. Jerome Powell has concluded his news conference following the announcement that the Federal Reserve will cut the country's key lending rate by a quarter point. ### 'We're committed to 2% inflation', Powell sayspublished at 20:15 GMT 10 December 2025 20:15 GMT 10 December 2025.
